dataset: Kaggle: Sound of 114 Species of Birds Till 2022 (xeno-canto recordings)
split: 80/10/10 stratified by species, split by recording, seed 42
model_input: 224x224x3 (spectrogram resized, copied to 3 channels, scaled to [-1,1])
augmentation: SpecAugment: 2 frequency masks (<=16 bands), 2 time masks (<=25 frames), time shift (+-30 frames), gain (+-15)
head: GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dropout(0.4) -> Dense(num_classes, softmax, L2 1e-4)
model_selection: best recording-level validation accuracy (mean of window predictions)
